# Fridge Contents Inventory

## Top Shelf
- **Butter lettuce/leaf lettuce** — 1-2 large heads — looks very fresh and crisp
- **Watermelon radish** — 1, halved — cut, should be used soon
- **Kohlrabi** — 1-2 — looks fresh
- **Red cabbage** — 1 half head — cut, use within a few days
- **White cabbage/napa cabbage** — partial head — needs attention soon

## Second Shelf
- **Baby carrots/small carrots** — ~15-20 pieces — fresh
- **Spinach/chard leaves** — large bunch, ~200-300g — fresh
- **Broccoli** — 1 large head — fresh, vibrant green
- **Beetroot** — 1 whole — fresh

## Third Shelf
- **Feta cheese** — ~200g block — in container
- **Butter** — ~250g block — in container
- **Tomato sauce/salsa** — 2 large jars — homemade-style
- **Small dark sauce** — 1 small jar
- **Preserved olives or jam** — 1 jar
- **Eggs** — ~6-8 eggs visible

## Bottom Shelf
- **Tomato preserves/sauce** — 1 large jar
- **Fresh parsley** — 1 large bunch — very fresh
- **Orange juice** — ~300ml in glass pitcher
- **Lemons** — 2-3 whole
Current pantry: butter, potatoes, okra, grilled chicken, carrots, prawns, greek yogurt, milk, onions, garlic, ginger, cumin, rice, soy sauce
